slidetranscripts.slidetranscript: <Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Welcome to the choose-your-own-PBIS-adventure series, featuring the middle school cafeteria! " /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Span Text="Before embarking on your PBIS adventure, begin by sharing your thoughts about disruptive behavior at an elementary school playground. After a brief description of the situation, you will be asked to rank several potential ideal remedies. Select the next arrow to begin." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Span Text="Welcome to Michigan Elementary School, where the staff are overwhelmed with the behaviors on the playground. Fourth, fifth, and sixth grade students are out of control, and it seems like no one is actually addressing behavior when it occurs on the playground. As a result, the behaviors spill over from the playground into the classroom and must be addressed by classroom teachers. Teachers report that students are battling about the rules of their games and arguing over how to use playground equipment. What starts out as a minor argument or disruption evolves into a screaming match that includes swearing, and in some cases, results in physical aggression or fighting. When playground supervisors try to intervene, they report that the students are disrespectful to them and do not listen to what they have to say. Teachers are spending the first five to ten minutes of class after recess dealing with playground issues instead of focusing on instruction. Many students are being sent to the office so that the principal can address their playground behavior." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Michigan Middle School serves just over 800 students in grades six through eight. While there are some good things about the school, the cafeteria is not one of them. Students are shoving and pushing to get in line quickly for the best lunch choices or the preferred seat at the best tables in the cafeteria. The language being used is disrespectful, and it is not uncommon to hear frequent swearing or other inappropriate language coming from students. In fact, the cafeteria staff are becoming so frustrated by this behavior that they are resorting to yelling at students and threatening detention or other consequences. This negative cycle between students and staff appears to be getting worse. Both students and staff report that it is “out of control” and not some place they want to be. Something has to change." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Span Text="Before the start of the staff meeting, the staff are complaining about student behavior in the cafeteria being "out of control." One teacher vocalized the general opinion. Given the feelings in the room, the principal decides to start the meeting talking about the cafeteria. Select the next arrow to take action!
" /> </Block> <Block /> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Span Text="During the next staff meeting, the School Leadership Team, or SLT shares the following precise problem statement based on the discipline referral data: 6th, 7th, and 8th grade students are using inappropriate language in the cafeteria from 11:25am to 1:00pm daily in order to obtain peer attention or objects such as preferred seats or lunch choices. Select the next arrow to take action!
" /> </Block> <Block /> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="The SLT gathered input from students, food service staff, lunchroom supervisors, and the rest of the staff. They proposed a plan during a staff meeting and opened it up to input and feedback: the plan was to increase active supervision and feedback.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="Lunchroom supervisors reviewed the plan for active supervision in the cafeteria, including movement, scanning, and interacting with students.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="Teachers from the class period prior to lunch agreed to stand in the hallways as students transition to the cafeteria to add some additional supervision.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="Select the next arrow to take action!" /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="After more consideration, the SLT team suggested additions to the original response plan.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style LeadingMargin="27" FirstLineMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6"> <ListStyle ListType="ListNumberedAsArabic" ListTypeFormat="Period" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="Environmental changes: The main schedule was adjusted slightly to allow for staggered release times from class periods that occur before lunch. This limits the number of students entering into the cafeteria and lunch line at any given time.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style LeadingMargin="27" FirstLineMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6"> <ListStyle ListType="ListNumberedAsArabic" ListTypeFormat="Period" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="Re-teaching: A school-wide plan for re-teaching cafeteria expectations that involves all staff (food service included) was created, leveraging the existing lesson plan for teaching expectations in the cafeteria. Video review lessons were designed by students and will be played during homeroom on a set schedule.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="Select the next arrow to take action!" /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Span Text="Before the start of the staff meeting, the staff are complaining about student behavior in the cafeteria being "out of control." One teacher vocalized the general opinion. Given the feelings in the room, the principal decides to start the meeting talking about the cafeteria. Select the next arrow to take action!
" /> </Block> <Block /> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Justification="Left" LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="At the next staff meeting, staff were more upset by the lack of "anything being done" to stop the level of behavior occurring in the cafeteria. Several teachers were very vocal in demanding that something be done. However, the staff meeting continues on. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Justification="Left" LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="Throughout the next few weeks, staff continue to talk about the continually increasing behavior in the cafeteria. They appear to be defeated by this and become resigned to it." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="Administration and staff hold a meeting to brainstorm. They discuss the issue and decide on next steps.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="Select the next arrow to take action!" /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="Teachers decide to increase "acknowledgement" by handing out as many Pride Bucks to kids as possible for everything and anything that students should be doing. Initially, students are excited about the Pride Bucks, resulting in some behavior change. However, without connecting the Pride Bucks to specific, expected cafeteria behaviors, the change is short-lived." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Justification="Left" LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="At the next staff meeting, staff were more upset by the lack of "anything being done" to stop the level of behavior occurring in the cafeteria. Several teachers were very vocal in demanding that something be done. However, the staff meeting continues on. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Justification="Left" LineSpacingRule="Single" SpacingBefore="6" /> <Span Text="Throughout the next few weeks, staff continue to talk about the continually increasing behavior in the cafeteria. They appear to be defeated by this and become resigned to it." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Span Text="At a staff meeting teachers start talking about how "out of control'' the cafeteria feels. As others join in, comments are heard around the room. Select the next arrow to take action!
" /> </Block> <Block /> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Span Text="Implementing this strategy will most likely result in a decrease in the behavior occurring in the cafeteria and the staff will be excited that this strategy is working! However, what we know about punitive strategies is that this behavior change will be short-lived. Select the next arrow to take action!
" /> </Block> <Block /> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Span Text="When the short-term behavior change "wears off' and disruptive student behavior begins again, it will likely be more intensive and more frequent than before the silent lunch and lunch detention system was put into place.
" /> </Block> <Block /> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Span Text="Now that you have completed your PBIS adventure, you have learned a lot about the influence of PBIS on student behavior. It's time to revisit the playground at Michigan Elementary! This time, watch the same description of the situation, and rank the same potential ideal remedies. Respond honestly again, and notice how you may have reframed your perspective of the circumstances after learning more about PBIS. Select the next arrow to begin." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Great job!" /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Span Text="Congratulations! You’ve survived the middle school cafeteria! Now that you have experienced first-hand how PBIS influences student behavior in a setting outside of the classroom, you’re ready to tackle the classroom setting! Stay tuned for yet another choose-your-own-PBIS adventure—featuring the classroom!" /> </Block> </Content> </Document>
